title: eludite.editor.rename output
description: What Rename did. From the UI thread (keys, the dialog) this is the state right after the request was sent, usually `loading`; from another thread (an agent) the call waits up to 5 s for the answer.

path.description: The document the request was made in.

line.description: 1-based line the request was made at.

column.description: 1-based column the request was made at.

state.description: `loading`: waiting for the language server; `dialog`: the Rename dialog is open with no preview yet; `preview`: the preview is computed (and shown in the dialog); `applied`: the rename was applied (see `summary`); `rejected`: nothing at the position can be renamed, or the language server refused the new name; `failed`: the request failed or the edit could not be applied.

new_name.description: The name the preview or the rename is for.

files.description: The preview: each file with its changed lines, in path order (at most 100 files, 100 lines each).

open.description: True when the file is open in an editor (it changes in the buffer, unsaved).

line.description: 1-based line in the file as it is before the rename.

total_edits.description: Text edits in the rename (all files).

summary.description: What the workspace-edit applier did (the same shape as the eludite.workspace.apply_edit output without `state`).

applied.description: True when every change was applied; false when the edit was refused (nothing was applied) or a write failed (see `message`).

files.description: Distinct files touched (edited, created, renamed or deleted).

open_documents.description: Open documents edited in their buffers (one undo step each, not saved).

files_on_disk.description: Closed files written on disk (atomically: a temporary file, then a rename).

paths.description: The absolute paths touched, sorted (at most 1000).

message.description: Why the edit was refused or failed.
